title: Type of Energieausweis not named
msg: The ad never says whether the certificate is an Energiebedarfsausweis or an Energieverbrauchsausweis.

title: Certificate type contradicts the value label
msg: The ad names both certificate types, or labels the value the opposite way to the type it declares.
fix: Keep one type. Endenergiebedarf belongs to a Bedarfsausweis, Endenergieverbrauch to a Verbrauchsausweis.

title: No Endenergie value in the ad
msg: No Endenergiebedarf or Endenergieverbrauch figure in kWh appears anywhere in the ad.
fix: Copy the number from the certificate, e.g. "Endenergiebedarf: 96,4 kWh/(m2*a)".

title: Energy value carries no per-square-metre-per-year unit
msg: A kWh figure is printed without the unit kWh/(m2*a), so the number does not state what the certificate states.
fix: Write the full unit: kWh/(m2*a), kWh/(m2·a) or kWh/(qm*a).

title: Energy value outside any plausible certificate range
msg: The printed value is outside 10-1000 kWh/(m2*a) and is almost certainly a typo or a unit mix-up.
fix: Re-read the value from the certificate before the ad goes live.

title: Main heating energy source missing
msg: The ad does not name the wesentlicher Energietraeger for heating that the certificate lists.
fix: Name it in words, e.g. "Wesentlicher Energietraeger: Erdgas".

title: Baujahr missing from a residential ad
msg: A Wohngebaeude ad must print the Baujahr named in the certificate, and this ad does not.
fix: Add "Baujahr: 1998" with the year from the certificate, not from the land registry.

title: Energieeffizienzklasse missing from a residential ad
msg: A Wohngebaeude ad must print the Energieeffizienzklasse named in the certificate, and this ad does not.
fix: Add "Energieeffizienzklasse: C" using the letter printed on the certificate.

title: Efficiency class letter does not exist
msg: The class letter in the ad is not one of the nine classes A+ to H.
fix: Use one of A+, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H.

title: Efficiency class contradicts the kWh value
msg: The kWh value in the ad falls in a different class band than the letter the ad prints.
fix: Re-read Anlage 10: the band the value falls in is the class that must be printed.

title: Non-residential ad does not split Waerme and Strom
msg: A Nichtwohngebaeude ad must list the Endenergie figure for Waerme and for Strom separately, and this ad lists one number.
fix: Print two lines, e.g. "Waerme: 120 kWh/(m2*a)" and "Strom: 45 kWh/(m2*a)".

title: Certificate older than ten years
msg: The issue date in the ad is more than ten years old, so the certificate behind these figures is no longer valid.
fix: Order a new certificate before the ad runs; a certificate is valid ten years from its issue date.

title: Template placeholder left in a mandatory field
msg: An unrendered template token or a filler such as "k.A." stands where a mandatory certificate figure belongs.
fix: Bind the field to the certificate record, and fail the build when the value is empty.
